name: Davis-Monthan AFB

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate. Visitor passes issued at the Craycroft Visitor Center Mon-Fri 0530-1900; after hours Craycroft IACP issues DBIDS passes.

gates.name: Craycroft Gate (Main Gate)

gates.name: S. Wilmot Gate
gates.notes: Inbound commercial traffic only. Closed on federal holidays.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Craycroft Gate)

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and complete MPF in-processing within required timelines. Attend the newcomers briefing at the M&FRC. Finance is in Bldg 3200, 3515 S Fifth St.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Management Office before arrival. All personnel must visit HMO before signing any off-base lease. Davis Monthan Inn (Heritage Inn) offers temporary lodging — book early during PCS season.

sections.title: Gate Access
sections.body: Craycroft Gate is open 24/7. Swan, Search, and N. Wilmot gates are Mon-Fri during posted hours. S. Wilmot is inbound commercial traffic only. Visitor Center outside Craycroft Gate: Mon-Fri 0530-1900. Gate operations: 520-228-3200.
